verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity documents an `id_number` verification type that checks a user's name, date of birth and national ID number without a document scan, and states that it validates SSNs. That covers the core of a document-free, database-backed check. Missing for 10: which authoritative data sources are used, country coverage beyond the US SSN, any credit-header data source, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the id_number flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can verify identity against authoritative databases without documents — SSN, national registries, or credit-header data — for lower-friction flows where a doc scan is overkill

citations.quote: id_number - Verify a user’s name, date of birth and national ID number.
Verify government-issued IDs, match documents to selfies, and validate SSNs to prevent fraud.
